title: Kirby's death in California and the night out before
summary: Kirby went to California and died young of diabetes; Procope recalls going out drinking with him unaware he wasn't supposed to.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: Then later on he went to California. He went to California, and that's where he ended it all up. That's where he died, in California. But again, you know, a young man. What was he, 37 years old? I think he was a few months older than I. x recte 43

Yeah. He was born around Christmas time and I was born in August. There was that difference in age. But he died a young man in California. He had diabetes. Yeah. Yeah. And he was drinking when he wasn't supposed to be drinking. I remember when we got to California, I was with Duke Ellington's band about this time, and I saw him when I went out to California, and you know, he came and got me and, you know, with his lady, and I didn't know that he wasn't supposed to be -- you know, we went out on the town. You know, just like in the old days, trying to recapture something. So when we got back to the house, she called me aside and she

said, "Has he been drinking?" I said yes. He always did drink. So she said he wasn't supposed to. Now, she should have told me that before. I didn't know that. So, lo and behold, he -- I never knew what he died from, but the way he died, I think he had a heart attack.
Seems as though he just gave one gasp and died, which sounds like a heart attack. Yeah.
